prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: desktop AI redesign concept bitmap for TALKPIK AI user app
Primary request: Create concept-02 for page 12-D-M1-submission-confirmation-modal, state modal-open. Reference state: Korean TOPIK writing screen dimmed behind a final submit modal. Create a distinct concept based on an exam submission receipt: the modal should feel like a precise pre-submit receipt rather than a generic alert.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 edge-to-edge app UI screenshot only; no browser address bar, tabs, bookmarks bar, OS window title bar, device frame, or watermark. Preserve the left navigation, writing workspace, right guide rail, and dim overlay. Center a wider modal with receipt-style grouped rows: problem number/type, answer length, last autosave status, submission destination, and analysis starts after submit. Put a compact checklist in two columns and keep actions fixed at bottom: secondary cancel, Obsidian final submit.
Style/medium: high-fidelity Ant Design-friendly SaaS UI, dense but readable, table-like row separators, quiet iconography, minimal shadows, 8px controls and 12px modal radius.
Color palette: Mist/Snow/Fog neutrals and Obsidian #09090b primary CTA only. Use green only for valid answer length/autosave confirmation; use gray warning surface for immutable notice. Avoid decorative color.
Typography: Cosmica-like modern sans, Korean UI text as visual direction only, compact title and labels, no negative letter spacing.
Must preserve state signals: dimmed background context, centered modal, final submission cannot be edited after submit, checklist, acknowledgement checkbox or equivalent confirmation gate, clear primary decision.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS frame, device frame, loud AI gradient, colorful submit button, large marketing hero type, nested cards, heavy drop shadows, overly rounded workspace controls.
